# Splice agent skills

Agent Skills for [Splice](https://splice.film.fun), film.fun's AI filmmaking studio. They teach an agent how to use Splice on the user's own account: generate and edit images, video, voice and music, build and cut a production, render motion graphics, run tested templates and check prices.

The skills are documents only: no code, no credentials. Every action goes through Splice's remote MCP server at `https://splice.film.fun/api/mcp` (OAuth sign-in on first connect), and anything that spends credits needs the user's Splice account.

Bundle version **1.4.0+skills.47e6a1992057** (MCP server 1.4.0, 14 skills). Each `SKILL.md` here is byte-identical to the copy Splice serves at [`/.well-known/agent-skills/`](https://splice.film.fun/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json); [`skills.json`](skills.json) lists the SHA-256 of each.

## Install

Every option below connects the same remote MCP server, `https://splice.film.fun/api/mcp`. Your agent opens a browser to sign in to Splice the first time it calls a tool. Prefer a key? Create one at https://splice.film.fun/dashboard/api-keys and send it as `Authorization: Bearer sk_...`.

### Claude Code

Plugin (skills plus the MCP server). Or MCP only: `claude mcp add --transport http splice https://splice.film.fun/api/mcp`, then `/mcp` to sign in.

```sh
claude plugin marketplace add Rogues-Lab/splice-agent-skills && claude plugin install splice@splice
```

### Codex

Adds this repo as a plugin marketplace; then run `codex`, open `/plugins` and install Splice. Or MCP only: `codex mcp add splice --url https://splice.film.fun/api/mcp` (it opens the sign-in; `codex mcp login splice` signs in again).

```sh
codex plugin marketplace add Rogues-Lab/splice-agent-skills
```

### Cursor

Installs the plugin locally; reload the window afterwards. Or MCP only, in one click: [Add to Cursor](https://cursor.com/en/install-mcp?name=splice&config=eyJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL3NwbGljZS5maWxtLmZ1bi9hcGkvbWNwIn0%3D).

```sh
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Rogues-Lab/splice-agent-skills ~/.cursor/plugins/local/splice
```

### VS Code

MCP only, in one click: [Install in VS Code](https://vscode.dev/redirect/mcp/install?name=splice&config=%7B%22type%22%3A%22http%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fsplice.film.fun%2Fapi%2Fmcp%22%7D).

```sh
code --add-mcp '{"name":"splice","type":"http","url":"https://splice.film.fun/api/mcp"}'
```

### Any Agent Skills host

Skills only (via skills.sh). Connect the MCP server in your host as well.

```sh
npx skills add Rogues-Lab/splice-agent-skills
```

A public docs server needs no sign-in at all (models, live prices, templates, docs search): `https://splice.film.fun/api/mcp/docs`.

## Check it works (free)

Ask your agent: "Use Splice to show my credit balance and the three cheapest image models." That calls `get_balance` and `list_models`, which never spend credits. If the agent asks you to sign in, finish the browser step and ask again. Step-by-step checks for each host: https://splice.film.fun/install.md

## Starter prompts

- **Check the connection** (free): "Use Splice to show my credit balance and the three cheapest image models."
- **Pick a video model** (free): "Which Splice video models can do 9:16 at 1080p, and what would a 6 second clip cost on each?"
- **First image** (spends credits): "With Splice, make a moody 16:9 still of a lighthouse keeper at dawn. Tell me the price before you generate."
- **Plan a short** (spends credits): "Plan a 30 second Splice short about a robot learning to paint: draft the script and shotlist, then tell me what shooting it would cost."
- **Title card** (spends credits): "Make a Splice motion title card that says "Night Shift" and show me PNG stills before rendering the MP4."
- **Pick up a production** (free): "What's next for my latest Splice production?"

Anything that generates, edits, upscales, renders or exports spends credits. The skills tell the agent to quote the price first and to pass an idempotency key, so a retry never charges twice.
